decision_mechanism.algorithm: Construct full declared positional IK Jacobian without regularization rows, pivoted QR, relative/absolute rank threshold; solve reduced declared-DOF subspace while freezing other DOFs at valid warm-start; independently measure every original goal residual; when candidate fails, retry with all declared DOFs. A retry cannot guarantee global nonlinear convergence.
